title: WORLD CLEANUP DAY: BA RIA VUNG TAU
summary: On September 21, Mainetti Vietnam partnered with Let's Do It Vietnam to hold World Cleanup Day – “Beach Cleanup” in Long Dien, Ba Ria - Vung Tau.

contentBlocks.value: On September 21, Mainetti Vietnam partnered with Let's Do It Vietnam to hold World Cleanup Day – “Beach Cleanup” in Long Dien, Ba Ria - Vung Tau.

The activity brought together more than 40 Mainettians to clean the beach together, collecting nearly 1.5 tons of waste.
This result reflects the collective effort of the Mainetti team, aiming to help spread the message about the importance of reducing waste, protecting the environment, and raising awareness of green living and sustainable development.

Mainetti Vietnam is part of the Mainetti Group, headquartered in the United Kingdom. The company specializes in manufacturing plastic products, particularly hangers and accessories for the fashion industry.
